d:
"Khalbatta" is a track where Dharmik flexes his lyrical skills with hard-hitting bars in Dakhni lingo, blending Hyderabadi slang to inspire a new generation. He compares himself to a "khalbatta" (mortar and pestle), while other rappers are the spices, showcasing his ability to grind and shape the rap game with his unique style
